items.exampleEn: These new shoes are very uncomfortable.
items.exampleZh: 這雙新鞋穿起來很不舒服。

items.exampleEn: I get inspiration for my stories from my dreams.
items.exampleZh: 我寫故事的靈感來自我的夢。
items.glossZh: 靈感；激勵人心的人事物

items.exampleEn: This job needs a lot of creativity.
items.exampleZh: 這份工作需要很多創意。
她贏的時候大家都在歡呼。
他今天看起來不太開心。

items.exampleEn: It's polite to say thank you.
items.exampleZh: 說謝謝是有禮貌的表現。

items.exampleEn: The long wait at the airport was unpleasant.
items.exampleZh: 在機場的漫長等待令人不愉快。

items.sentenceEn: Fortunately, the rain stopped before the game.

items.audioEn: The hotel bed was so uncomfortable that I couldn't sleep.
items.audioZh: 旅館的床太不舒服了，我根本睡不著。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼睡不著？
options: The room next door was noisy

items.sentenceEn: The children are always polite to their teachers.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們對老師總是很有禮貌。

items.sentenceEn: We all cheered for our team.
items.sentenceZh: 我們都為自己的隊伍歡呼。

items.stemEn: He always says please and thank you. He is very ____.
items.stemZh: 他總是把「請」和「謝謝」掛在嘴邊，非常有禮貌。

items.stemEn: I lost my wallet. ____, a kind man found it and gave it back.
items.stemZh: 我弄丟了錢包。幸好有位好心人撿到並還給了我。

items.passageEn: Linda was unhappy at her old office job. The office was cold and uncomfortable, and her boss was often unpleasant. She wanted a job with more creativity. Fortunately, a small art school offered her a job. Now she teaches children to paint. "My students are my inspiration," she says. When the children show their pictures, everyone cheers.
items.passageZh: Linda 以前在辦公室上班時並不快樂。辦公室又冷又不舒服，老闆也常常讓人很不愉快。她想要一份更有創意的工作。幸好，一間小小的美術教室提供了她一份工作。現在她教孩子們畫畫。她說：「我的學生就是我的靈感來源。」每當孩子們展示自己的畫，大家都會歡呼。

questions.questionZh: Linda 以前的工作為什麼讓她不快樂？
options: 薪水太少，而且每天都要加班到很晚才回家
辦公室不舒服，老闆也常讓人不愉快
辦公室離她家實在太遠

items.promptZh: 這件事讓我覺得很不自在。
referenceEn: This makes me feel very uncomfortable.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 makes me feel uncomfortable、I feel uncomfortable about this
主詞是 This 時，動詞要加 s（例如 makes）

items.instructionZh: 用 polite 造一個句子，說說某人有禮貌的表現，或什麼是有禮貌的行為。
referenceEn: My son is always polite to older people.
It's polite to hold the door for others.
rubricZh: polite 表示「有禮貌的」，可寫例如 be polite to＋人、It's polite to＋原形動詞
主詞和 be 動詞要搭配（例如 My son is）
